findings.summary: Unconditionally persisting the default 'current' value gives every existing visitor a year-long override, so changing the default to v4 at launch leaves those visitors on the old site unless launch also migrates or invalidates these cookies.

Referencing Prodiga only in v4 CSS cannot guarantee current visitors never download it because vite.config.js precaches all built .woff2 assets; meeting this promise requires a precache exclusion despite service-worker changes being deferred until launch.

Deleting the current pages during cleanup removes the only implementations of About, Add Node, Register, Donate and Report, which §7 explicitly leaves as tokenised current pages without v4 replacements.
